title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Annual Out-of-Pocket Maximums
content:
The out-of-pocket maximum is the most a member pays in member cost share in one plan year under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan. Every design sets an individual maximum and a family maximum, and on every design the amounts a member pays toward the deductible also count toward the out-of-pocket maximum.

| Plan design | Individual out-of-pocket maximum (USD) | Family out-of-pocket maximum (USD) | Deductible payments count toward the maximum |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | 6500.00 | 13000.00 | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | 4200.00 | 8400.00 | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Value | 3600.00 | 7200.00 | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Select | 3000.00 | 6000.00 | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | 2500.00 | 5000.00 | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | 1800.00 | 3600.00 | Yes |

## Questions this schedule answers

**Is the family maximum a separate amount from the individual maximum?**
Yes. Each design states both. On every design in the lineup the family maximum is exactly twice the individual maximum.

**Do deductible payments count toward these maximums?**
Yes, on all six designs. A dollar the member pays toward the deductible is also a dollar toward the out-of-pocket maximum.

**Which design has the lowest individual maximum?**
Northbridge Rx Premier, at 1800.00 per plan year; the highest is Northbridge Rx HSA Saver, at 6500.00.

### Illustration (hypothetical member)

A hypothetical member on Northbridge Rx Value pays 200.00 toward the deductible and 900.00 in copays in one plan year. Because deductible payments count, the member has met 1100.00 of the individual maximum of 3600.00, leaving 2500.00.
